question: How many rare enchantment Abundance cards are there whose play format status are all legal?
evidence: rare refers to rarity = 'rare'; enchantment card refers to types = 'Enchantment'; Abundance cards refers to name = 'Abundance'; format status are all legal refers to status = 'Legal'
clarification: Count each distinct id only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.rarity = 'rare' AND T1.types = 'Enchantment' AND T1.name = 'Abundance' AND T2.status = 'Legal'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.rarity = 'rare' AND T1.types = 'Enchantment' AND T1.name = 'Abundance' AND T2.status = 'Legal'

d.request: How many distinct rare enchantment Abundance cards (by distinct id) are there whose play format statuses are all legal?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards c WHERE c.name = 'Abundance' AND c.rarity = 'rare' AND c.types = 'Enchantment' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalities l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalities l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid AND l.status <> 'Legal')
